environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with two rule conditions evaluated in sequence. The ALB target group has a health check on /api/v1/health. The ALB listener on port 443 has three rules: (1) a fixed-response rule returning 403 for any request where the query string contains a percent-encoded apostrophe (%27) OR literal apostrophe in query parameters, evaluated via ALB query-string condition matching; (2) an AWS WAF v2 WebACL associated with the ALB containing rule group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' with SizeRestriction_QUERYSTRING rule (max 1024 bytes) in COUNT mode, AND a custom rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP; (3) a custom WAF rule using regex pattern set that inspects QUERY_STRING with pattern "(?i)(?:union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|exec|benchmark|sleep|load_file|into\s+outfile)" with action BLOCK and priority 0 (highest). The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch alarms trigger on WAF blocked requests.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with HTTPS listener (TLS termination)
config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet
config.runtime: ECS Fargate, no public IP on task
